concept: IAM Identity Center: centralized workforce SSO across many accounts
tests: Choosing a service to centrally manage employee access to multiple accounts with an external IdP.
expected: AWS IAM Identity Center — SSO, external IdP integration, permission sets assigned to accounts. Triggers: "human users", "multiple AWS accounts", "single sign-on", "external identity provider".
why_not: Cognito identity pools — for application end users; STS only issues credentials; IAM groups in each account — not centralized.
